negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic render, glossy plastic skin, smooth flat digital vector, photorealistic human skin, young person, bright neon lighting, sad expression, deformed faces, extra limbs, separated scarves, outer decorative border, ornate frame, picture frame
reconstruction_priority: Intimate nose-to-nose contact and shared continuous knit scarf — AI tends to separate the characters onto different planes or render two separate disconnected scarves.
Curly textured sheep-wool hair ringlets — AI often flattens curly fiber textures into smooth digital hair.
Expressive stylized smiling facial expressions with crescent closed eyes and open laughing mouths — AI tends to draw open staring cartoon eyes or photorealistic teeth.
Tactile contrast between chunky rib-knit wool and smooth matte clay faces — AI often blurs material boundaries into uniform plastic.
